hero.title: Igniting Potential, Inspiring Change.
hero.subtitle: We believe every child is a spark of genius. We provide the tools, mentorship, and opportunities to set that genius free.

about.heading: Igniting the genius in every child.
about.p1: Zeal Care is a nonprofit organization headquartered in Monrovia, Liberia. We are dedicated to empowering Africa's future leaders through comprehensive education, focused mentorship, and crucial technology access.
about.p2: We have partnered with local communities — including Esfans Academy at West Point Zone 405 — to break down barriers to success. We don't just provide resources; we build pathways for children to discover their potential and transform their communities.
about.quote: When you give a child the right tools and someone who believes in them, their potential is limitless.

why.heading: A Holistic Approach to Change
why.subtitle: We address the root causes of inequality through four core pillars, creating a comprehensive foundation for success.

features.title: Education Access
features.desc: Providing scholarships, school supplies, and removing financial barriers so every child can attend school.

features.title: Technology Skills
features.desc: Equipping students with modern computer labs and coding classes to prepare them for the digital economy.

features.title: Mentorship Programs
features.desc: Pairing youth with dedicated role models who guide their personal and professional development.

features.title: Community Impact
features.desc: Building sustainable local programs that uplift entire neighborhoods, not just individuals.

items.title: Scholar Support
items.desc: Comprehensive scholarships covering tuition, school supplies, uniforms, and backpacks for promising students who need it most.

items.title: Tech Education
items.desc: State-of-the-art computer labs teaching digital literacy, coding, and modern software skills to prepare youth for the digital economy.

items.title: Classroom Engagement
items.desc: Active school visits and interactive learning sessions that inspire curiosity, build confidence, and make education exciting.

items.title: Community Outreach
items.desc: Engaging families, local leaders, and households to build supportive environments where every child's education is valued.
